# Speed and accuracy

ROAR-Sentence is a timed reading task: the child reads short sentences and
says whether each is true or false, as many as they can in the time
allowed. The score is correct minus incorrect answers per second (the
subtraction cancels guessing), scaled.

```{r sre-runs}
sre_runs <- trials |>
  filter(!is.na(correct)) |>
  group_by(run_id) |>
  summarise(attempted = n(), accuracy = mean(correct), .groups = "drop") |>
  inner_join(first_runs |> select(run_id, dataset, age, score), by = "run_id")
sre_cor <- bind_rows(
  sre_runs |> reframe(cor_ci(score, attempted)) |> mutate(with = "sentences attempted"),
  sre_runs |> reframe(cor_ci(score, accuracy)) |> mutate(with = "accuracy"))
```

```{r sre-plot, fig.height=4}
#| label: fig-sre-speed
#| fig-cap: "Sentences attempted and accuracy on each child's first run, by age, with a smooth for each dataset."
sre_runs |>
  filter(!is.na(age)) |>
  pivot_longer(c(attempted, accuracy), names_to = "measure") |>
  mutate(measure = c(attempted = "Sentences attempted", accuracy = "Accuracy")[measure]) |>
  by_ds() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = value, colour = dataset)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 1, se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(vars(measure), scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_dataset(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = NULL)
```

On first runs, the score correlates
`r with(sre_cor, paste0("r = ", f2(r), " with ", with, " (95% CI ", f2(lo), "–", f2(hi), ")", collapse = " and "))`
(n = `r fmt_n(sre_cor$n[1])`). Children attempt a median of
`r median(sre_runs$attempted)` sentences, at a median accuracy of
`r f2(median(sre_runs$accuracy))`.
